body:
🔐 Advanced Lock – Secure Your Chests with Codes

Advanced Lock is a security-focused Forge mod that adds a realistic and user-friendly chest locking system to Minecraft.

This mod allows players to protect their chests using numeric access codes, preventing unauthorized access, theft, and destruction.

✨ Features
🔒 Chest Locking with Codes

Players can lock any single or double chest using a special Padlock / Key item.

Each chest can be protected with a custom numeric code.

Only players who know the correct code can open the chest.

🧠 Owner Protection

Every locked chest stores its owner.

Even the owner must enter the code to open the chest, adding realism and balance.

Chests cannot be bypassed by breaking or force-opening.

🧱 Break Protection

Locked chests cannot be broken unless the correct code is provided.

This prevents griefing and item loss on multiplayer servers.

🖥️ Interactive GUI

When a player interacts with a locked chest, a clean GUI screen appears.

The GUI allows players to:

Enter the unlock code

Set a new code (owner only)

Remove the code (owner only)

Clear feedback messages are shown for correct or incorrect codes.

🌐 Multiplayer & Server Friendly

Fully server-side + client-side compatible.

Chest codes and ownership are saved securely on the server.

Works perfectly in survival multiplayer environments.

🔑 Custom Items & Textures

Includes a custom Key / Padlock item with its own texture.

Supports resource packs and future expansion.

🎮 Player Experience

With Advanced Lock installed:

Players can safely store valuable items without fear of theft.

Servers gain a realistic security system without relying on claims or regions.

Bases, shops, and storage rooms feel more immersive and meaningful.

PvE and RP servers especially benefit from added realism and trust mechanics.

Example use cases:

Lock your base storage on a multiplayer server

Create secure shops or banks

Protect loot rooms or secret chests

⚙️ Compatibility

Minecraft 1.18.2

Forge 40.x

Designed for survival and multiplayer servers

📦 Why Use Advanced Lock?

Advanced Lock focuses on simplicity, realism, and security.
It enhances the vanilla chest system without changing Minecraft’s core mechanics, making it easy to learn while powerful in gameplay impact.
